We propose a novel model of online advertising networks, and describe the problem of hit inflation.

(a) the advertising network model can be abstracted as a stream of data that can be analyzed using online algorithms; (b) the hit inflation techniques can be categorized into three classes: (i) the click fraud attacks, (ii) the click inflation attacks, and (iii) the hit inflation attacks; (c) the hit inflation problem can be abstracted to a stream analysis problem, and can be solved by online algorithms.
